episodes.title: Chapter 1: Delivery Accident
episodes.summary: A secret project being carried out in Korea is discovered by an American intelligence agency. Director Choi decides to retrieve the sample.

episodes.title: Chapter 2: The Sweepers
episodes.summary: A retired veteran member of the organization. Lim Sang is asked to eliminate not only the Mo Yong who participated in the operation, but also Ja Kyung.

episodes.title: Chapter 3: The Pursuers
episodes.summary: Ja-gyeong and Lim Sang each pursue Mo-yong and come face to face. American agent Paul confronts Director Choi in person to retrieve the sample.

episodes.title: Chapter 4: The Tyrant
episodes.summary: Everyone gathers in one place. Who will get the last sample? Something unexpected will happen.
